title: Room for the Trucks

mood.label: Uneasy calm
mood.summary: Uneasy calm: Iran calls US talks not serious and a ship burns off Iraq, Jordan strikes Syria after a church attack, a rig sinks off Gabon. But Kherson's guns pause for aid to Oleshky, Brazil's losers concede, and river dolphins number six more.

style.genre: motorik krautrock — dulcimer, reed organ, picked bass, TR-909

lines: Not serious, Tehran says of the talks,
a ship burns off the Iraqi shore;
Jordan answers a church with jets,
a platform sinks off Gabon, and more.
The real slides down in São Paulo,
but Bolsonaro's people signed the count
and in Tehran the envoys stay.
Hold the guns on Kherson road,
make room for the trucks to pass,
six more dolphins in the river,
an uneasy calm, but calm at last.
